rules.text: Fitness trackers and smart watches must be returned within 10 days of purchase with a sales receipt and in original condition.
rules.quote: Must be returned within 10 days of purchase with a sales receipt, unworn, and unaltered in original condition with packaging and any accompanying accessories.
rules.reviewNote: The summary omits that the item must be 'unworn, and unaltered' and must include packaging and accessories, which are specified in the quote.

rules.text: Holiday purchases made on or after October 1st may be returned through January 31st of the following year with an original or gift receipt.
rules.quote: Most purchases made on or after October 1st may be returned through January 31st, 2027 with an original or gift receipt.
rules.reviewNote: The summary omits that the policy applies to 'most purchases' and not all purchases, as specified in the quote.

rules.text: Most purchases are eligible for return or exchange within 60 days of the original purchase date with a receipt.
rules.quote: Simply bring your item(s) and your receipt within 60 days of the purchase date and an associate will be happy to assist you.

rules.text: Most merchandise purchased in the last 60 days can be exchanged at any JCPenney location.
rules.quote: We are happy to exchange most merchandise purchased in the last 60 days at any JCPenney location.

rules.text: Returns with a receipt will be refunded on the original form of payment or JCPenney Gift Card.
rules.quote: Refunds will be issued on the original form of payment or JCPenney Gift Card.

rules.text: Returns without a receipt may be eligible for a merchandise return voucher at the item's lowest selling price in the last 45 days when accompanied by valid ID.
rules.quote: Returns without a receipt may be eligible for a JCPenney Merchandise Return Voucher at the item’s lowest selling price in the last 45 days when accompanied by a valid ID.

rules.text: Valid photo identification is required for all non-receipted returns or exchanges and information is retained to monitor returns.
rules.quote: Valid photo identification is required for all non-receipted returns or exchanges. Information from the ID will be retained in a secured company-wide database to monitor the number of un-receipted returns.

rules.text: Gift Cards, Donations, Monogrammed Items, Personalized Items, Altered Items, Body Jewelry, Face Masks, False/Fake Eyelashes, Ear Piercing Kits, Perishable Foods, Services, shipping & handling charges and Colorado delivery fees cannot be returned.
rules.quote: Gift Cards, Donations, Monogrammed Items, Personalized Items, Altered Items, Body Jewelry, Face Masks, False/Fake Eyelashes, Ear Piercing Kits, Perishable Foods, Services, jcp.com Shipping & Handling Charges and Colorado Delivery Fees.

rules.text: Refunds to a JCPenney Credit Card typically take up to 4 business days to post after merchandise is received.
rules.quote: Refunds to a JCPenney Credit Card typically take up to 4 business days to post to your account from the day the merchandise was received.

rules.text: Refunds to bank or debit cards typically take up to 10 business days to post after merchandise is received.
rules.quote: It typically takes up to 10 business days to post to your account from the day the merchandise was received.

rules.text: Within 14 days after purchase, JCPenney will match a lower advertised price on an identical item and refund the difference.
rules.quote: Within 14 days after your purchase, if you find a lower, currently advertised price on an identical item at a competitor, just bring the ad to a JCPenney store and we’ll match that price and refund you the difference.
rules.reviewNote: The summary omits that the lower price must be 'currently advertised' and at a 'competitor,' which are specified in the quote.
